question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"serve"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the blank number 1 is 'serve.'
 
• Serve: to work for, or to carry out your duty.(सेवा करना)
 
 
• Example:* If memory **serves **me right, I was 13 at the time.*
 
 
 
• *The sentence implies that the person will not consider anything if he does not believes in it.*
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.​

Correct Paragraph: *I will tell you what I will do and what I will not do. I will not **(1) serve__ **that in which I no longer believe, (2) ______ it calls itself my home, my fatherland, or my church: and I will try to (3) ______ myself in some mode of life or art as (4) ______ as I can and as wholly as I can, using for my defense the only arms I (5) ______myself to use: silence, exile and cunning.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the **meaning **and usage of the other options.

 
 

 Words 
 Meaning
 Examples
 
 

 Drain
 to make someone very tired.(किसी को बहुत थका देना)
 The long journey completely drained me.
 
 

 Lag
 to move or make progress so slowly that you are behind other people or things.(विलंबन)
 Sales are lagging at the moment.
 
 

 Debit
 a record of money taken out of a bank account (रक़मनामे लिखना)
 The account was in debit at the end of the month.
